concerns.text: T016 (SVD computation) and T018 (Mask generation) are listed BEFORE T015 (Full-Parameter OPD Baseline). The SVD task requires 'per-layer deltas' which are the output of the baseline training (T015). A consumer (T016) cannot precede its producer (T015). T015 must be moved before T016.
T044 (Checksum validation) is listed AFTER T041 (Checksum computation). T044 depends on the existence of the checksums file generated by T041. The consumer (T044) must follow the producer (T041).

T019 (Frozen-Subspace OPD) and T022 (Orchestration) are listed before T016/T018 (Mask Generation). The Frozen-Subspace training requires the binary mask artifact produced by the SVD/Mask tasks. The mask generation tasks (T016, T018) must precede any task that consumes the mask (T019, T022).

T026 (Frozen-Subspace SFT) and T030 (Orchestration) are listed before T016/T018 (Mask Generation). Similar to US1, the SFT runs in the OPD subspace require the mask artifact. T016/T018 must precede T026/T030.
T027 (Random Mask Training) is listed before T025 (Random Mask Generator). T027 consumes the random mask artifact produced by T025. Producer T025 must precede consumer T027.

T061 (Export state.yaml) is listed before T032 (Run All) and T032b (Generate Unified Summary). T061 consumes the aggregated results from T032/T032b. The producer (T032/T032b) must precede the consumer (T061).
T033 (Write ci_metrics.json) is listed before T032 (Run All). The metrics summary depends on the completion of the full pipeline orchestrated by T032. T032 must precede T033.

T009b (Split GSM8K) is listed after T009 (Download GSM8K) but before T041 (Compute Checksums). While T009b logically follows T009, T041 (Checksums) should ideally be computed on the final split files or the download artifacts before splitting if the checksums are for the raw download. However, the critical ordering violation is T016/T018 depending on T015. T009b is acceptable after T009, but T041 should be verified against the final data state used by T009b.
